finding.assessment: This updates the prior provisional assessment: previously no post-approval outcome evidence existed for live-pg-a, so resolution could not be confirmed either way. Now cold_check evidence is available and it disconfirms resolution — the approve verdict and reviewer's claimed fix did not hold up under later checking. landed_sha is still absent, so full landing/deployment status remains unconfirmed.

citations.excerpt: A later check still fails on empty input after merge. The earlier reviewer repair did not resolve the recurrence.
Reviewer fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.

finding.contradictions: Direct contradiction within live-pg-a's own record: review_report asserts the validation issue was fixed with a regression test, while cold_check explicitly states the same failure still occurs on empty input after merge.
finding.explanation: New evidence for live-pg-a now includes a populated cold_check field (previously nil), which directly contradicts the review_report's claim that the missing empty-input validation was fixed. The cold_check reports the same failure recurring after merge, even though a reviewer diff and regression test were added.
finding.facts: live-pg-a record now shows cold_check: {passed: false, report: 'A later check still fails on empty input after merge. The earlier reviewer repair did not resolve the recurrence.'}. landed_sha remains nil and recovery_attempts remains 0. review_report still states the reviewer 'fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test' (reviewer_diff_size: 18).
finding.hypothesis: The reviewer's diff or regression test likely addressed only a narrow or surface-level case of empty-input handling rather than the actual failure path exercised by the later cold check, so the underlying gap persisted despite appearing resolved at review time.
finding.improvement: N/A for this advisory role; noting only that the discrepancy between review_report and cold_check suggests review-time validation/tests were insufficient to catch the recurrence.
finding.recurrence: This is a same-run recurrence (not just cross-run): the identical empty-input validation gap previously flagged as fixed in live-pg-a has now been shown, via cold_check, to persist post-merge. The prior cross-run pattern with live-pg-b (same missing-validation issue, identical output hashes) is not re-confirmed here since live-pg-b is not present in this evidence page.
finding.title: Cold-check evidence shows the reviewer's empty-input fix did not actually resolve the issue in live-pg-a

revisions.assessment: Both runs reached verdict=approve only after reviewer intervention, not from the agent's original output. Neither run has landed_sha or cold_check populated, so no post-approval landing/outcome evidence is available in this page — approval alone does not establish the fix is confirmed resolved.

citations.excerpt: Reviewer fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.
Reviewer again fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.

revisions.contradictions: The identical agent_output_hash and reviewer_output_hash across two different run_ids/projects is unusual for independent runs; without more evidence this could reflect duplicated/mirrored data rather than two distinct instances of the same agent gap, so the 'recurring' framing is provisional.
revisions.explanation: Two separate runs (live-pg-a in project insights-pg, live-pg-b in project insights-other) both ended in state=done/verdict=approve, and in both cases the review_report states the reviewer had to add empty-input validation and a regression test that the agent's own output lacked. Both runs also share identical agent_output_hash (dbe79a86f48dd9170408d2fb16c38bb3) and reviewer_output_hash (975dd9dcd0f24a56206be4683f08391f) despite being different run_ids/projects.
revisions.facts: live-pg-a record: review_report='Reviewer fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.' live-pg-b record: review_report='Reviewer again fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.' Both records show recovery_attempts:0, landed_sha:nil, cold_check:nil. agent_output_hash and reviewer_output_hash are identical strings across both runs.
revisions.hypothesis: The agent may be systematically omitting empty-input validation as a generation gap (e.g., a prompt/skill blind spot), and the reviewer step is compensating consistently. The identical hashes across two distinct run_ids/projects could indicate a shared/templated agent output being reused, or could reflect a genuine coincidence/data-pipeline duplication rather than independent agent runs — this should be treated as an anomaly, not confirmed causation.
revisions.improvement: If the agent output was genuinely regenerated independently in both cases, consider whether the underlying skill/prompt should explicitly require empty-input validation to reduce reliance on reviewer correction.
revisions.recurrence: Same missing empty-input validation issue reported in both live-pg-a and live-pg-b records within this evidence page; no prior findings exist in this history to cross-reference by id.
revisions.title: Missing empty-input validation recurs across two runs with identical output fingerprints
